children: Albany International's chief financial officer, Willard Station, is taking a medical leave of absence from the textiles and materials processing company.
Albany on Monday said Sean Valashinas, its controller and chief accounting officer, will serve as acting finance chief of the Portsmouth, N.H., company.
Station and Valashinas both joined the company last year.
